data.body: **[P1] Keep PR-authored workflows off the account runner.** A `pull_request` uses the PR's workflow definition, so a fork can alter this expression—or the gates in the other migrated workflows—to request the predictable CodeBuild label. Dependabot PRs already select CodeBuild because their head repository equals the base repository. Untrusted build code can therefore run with the CodeBuild job's AWS role and network context. Enforce this trust decision outside PR-controlled YAML, such as with a base-controlled `pull_request_target`/`workflow_run` dispatcher that verifies a same-repository, non-bot head, plus a CodeBuild webhook/project policy that rejects direct PR jobs.
